stage2_parent_rule: Best mixed stage-one arm on the winner background, macro Dice then HD95 then ID; mirror exact AP settings across backgrounds.
stage3_rule: Best change per factor must improve the stage-one mixed parent by >=0.0005 macro Dice; require >=2 factors; at most 16 joint configurations mirrored on both backgrounds.
geometry: Use existing original A/P labels. Native foreground only. Independent endpoints at 1 and 3 mm pair separations, preserving the class along each path. No fitted plane and no validation-label model input.
calibration: Freeze background coefficients; independently normalize AP band and pair gradients, apply shares, jointly calibrate the AP sum at 0.025/0.05/0.10 relative to full background loss with p95 cap 0.5. Training data only.
queue_order: Thirty AP mechanism/strength runs first, selected unfinished outer-loss runs, forty-four AP block refinements, then supported bounded interactions.
